summary: Frontend testing of Blockchain Verified Ledger and AI-ML Trading Analysis features for Nutrition Trading section. All 9 features tested and PASSED. The ledger tracks buy/sell transactions with blockchain-style tx hashes, block numbers, and confirmations. Portfolio tracks holdings with average buy price and calculates unrealized P/L. AI prediction panel shows trading signals, confidence %, risk level, and technical indicators.
seed_data_creation: Test data created via localStorage for portfolio and transaction ledger testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blockchain Ledger and AI-ML Trading Analysis features fully functional. All buy/sell flows work correctly with proper P/L tracking. localStorage persistence verified for portfolio and transaction ledger.

features_tested.feature: Blockchain Ledger Modal opens when clicking 'View Blockchain Ledger' button
features_tested.details: Button with data-testid='view-ledger-btn' opens modal correctly. Shows transaction count badge.

features_tested.feature: Ledger shows portfolio summary with Total Holdings, Total Invested, Unrealized P/L, Total Transactions
features_tested.details: All 4 summary cards visible: Total Holdings (X Products), Total Invested (X FTC), Unrealized P/L (+/-X FTC), Total Transactions (count)

features_tested.feature: AI-ML Trading Analysis panel appears in nutrition trade modal
features_tested.details: Panel shows Signal (STRONG BUY/BUY/HOLD/SELL/STRONG SELL), Confidence %, Risk (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), RSI, MACD, Sentiment (Bullish/Bearish), Target price

features_tested.feature: Buy nutrition product updates portfolio and creates ledger entry with blockchain-style tx hash
features_tested.details: Buy transaction creates ledger entry with: tx hash (0x...), block number, confirmations, product details, price, total FTC. Portfolio updated with quantity and avg buy price.

features_tested.feature: Sell nutrition product calculates realized P/L and records in ledger
features_tested.details: Sell transaction shows realized P/L in toast notification and ledger entry. P/L calculated as (sell price - avg buy price) * quantity.
localStorage key 'ftc_portfolio' stores holdings with quantity, avgBuyPrice, totalInvested per product
localStorage key 'ftc_transaction_ledger' stores up to 100 transactions with full details

features_tested.feature: Product cards show user's holdings with P/L when logged in
features_tested.details: Cards show 'X owned' badge and P/L in FTC and percentage when user has holdings

features_tested.feature: Sell is disabled when user has no holdings
features_tested.details: Sell button shows 'Insufficient Holdings' (disabled) when user has no holdings for that product

mocked_apis_list: AI-ML predictions are generated client-side using price history analysis (generateAIPrediction function), not from external API

ledger_modal_elements: Header: 'Blockchain Verified Ledger' with 'Real-time transaction history • AI-ML Powered'
Portfolio Summary: 4 cards (Total Holdings, Total Invested, Unrealized P/L, Total Transactions)
Active Holdings section: Shows each product with quantity, avg buy price, and P/L
Transaction History: Shows BUY/SELL transactions with amount, price, total, P/L (for sells)
Transaction details: TX hash, Block number, confirmations
Footer: 'AI-ML Trading Analysis Active' | 'All transactions blockchain verified'
